verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://docs.reducto.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of Markdown doc pages. Several docs pages are served as .md files (parse, cli, mcp-server, classify), and an OpenAPI spec is published, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on using the docs with agents, and no independent community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Reducto CLI gives you direct terminal access to Reducto's document capabilities
